expr: (() => { const S=window.simState; return S.orb==='o1s' && S.N===1000 && S.p===90 && S.seed===1 ? 1 : 0 })()
note: on load: 1s, N = 1000, p = 90 %, first series (must run before any setup)
on load: 1s 90 % boundary radius 0,141 nm (lesson-answers R1s-90)

expr: (() => { const S=window.simState; return S.k + S.out === S.N && Math.abs(S.frac - 100 * S.k / S.N) < 1e-9 ? 1 : 0 })()
note: on load: k + (N - k) = N and frac = 100 k / N

expr: (() => { const R=document.querySelectorAll('#sim-root input[type=range]'); return R.length===1 && R[0].min==='50' && R[0].max==='95' && R[0].step==='5' ? 1 : 0 })()
note: one slider: threshold p 50–95 % in steps of 5
two selects: state 1s/2s/2p and number of measurements 1, 10, 100, 1000, 5000

expr: (() => { const k=[...document.getElementById('sim-root').children].map(e=>e.tagName==='CANVAS'?'canvas':e.className); const c=document.querySelector('#sim-root .controls'); return k.indexOf('canvas')<k.indexOf('controls') && k.indexOf('controls')<k.indexOf('readout') && c.firstElementChild.tagName==='BUTTON' ? 1 : 0 })()
note: DOM order canvas, controls (main button first), readout

expr: (() => { const n=document.querySelectorAll('#sim-root p.note'); return !document.querySelector('#sim-root details') && n.length===1 && n[0].textContent.trim().split(/\s+/).length<=15 ? 1 : 0 })()
note: no Lisätietoja box; one legend line of at most 15 words

expr: (() => { const P=window.simAdapter && window.simAdapter.params; return P && Object.keys(P).sort().join(',')==='N,orb,p' && P.p.unit==='%' ? 1 : 0 })()
note: adapter declares orb, N and p (%)

expr: (() => { const c=document.querySelector('#sim-root canvas'); const w=document.getElementById('sim-root').clientWidth; return c.width===600 && c.height===(w<500?800:400) ? 1 : 0; })()
note: canvas 600x400 on a wide screen, 600x800 (stacked, larger labels) under 500 px
the readout shows the fraction in % and the distances in nm
